command: SCRIPT=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 'http://192.168.0.16/rpc/Script.GetStatus?id=1'); RELAY=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 'http://192.168.0.16/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0'); SCRIPT="$SCRIPT" RELAY="$RELAY" python3 -c 'import json,os; assert json.loads(os.environ["SCRIPT"]).get("running") is True; assert json.loads(os.environ["RELAY"]).get("output") is False'
